name: Read it for me
description: Paste a link, with a question if you have one: context.dev reads the page (only the passages that answer your question, when there is one) and NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Lightning answers from what it read. Your notes go to neither. Needs CONTEXT_DEV_API_KEY and NEBIUS_API_KEY.

assistants.name: Page reader (context.dev)
assistants.description: Reads a web page, or just the parts of it that answer a question.

assistants.name: Answer (Nemotron Lightning)
assistants.description: Quick answers from text it's given.
